impact_scope.description: S1 introduces the public ares_search_dnsrec entry point, which accepts a caller-created DNS record and returns a parsed DNS record through a new callback type.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration for ares_search_dnsrec in the selected production files.
Because this anchored public API does not exist in S0, its own exposure obligation and gap do not exist in S0.
S1 declares ares_search_dnsrec in include/ares.h and implements it in src/lib/ares_search.c.
H0 calls ares_create_query and several ares_parse_*_reply functions, but never calls ares_search_dnsrec or supplies its DNS-record callback lifecycle.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add a call path that creates or populates an ares_dns_record_t, invokes ares_search_dnsrec with a channel and ares_callback_dnsrec callback, and drives the asynchronous operation sufficiently to exercise its result handling.
evidence: The new API requires caller-supplied channel, DNS-record object, callback, and callback argument.
No S0 action could expose this exact entry point because it was absent.

reason: The smallest anchored fuzz-relevant semantic unit is the newly introduced public ares_search_dnsrec API. Its same-scope gap is false in S0 because the declaration is absent, and true in S1 because unchanged H0 does not invoke it. This creates a concrete new harness call and lifecycle obligation, so the delta is NEW and maintenance is needed.
